publishedfiledetails.title: Womp, The Abyssal
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Adds a new character to play as in DST.

[b]Basic rundown:[/b]
HP: 120
Hunger: 200
Sanity: 100

*Benefits from moisture, suffers when dry
*Has a very good grip
*Is a monster

Womp includes a custom speech file, art, sound effects and unique perks.

[b]Here's a more detailed breakdown of some of the things Womp does:[/b]
(If you'd rather learn the character by playing him, don't read below.)

[b]Things to Note:[/b]
- Womp constantly generates wetness over time.
- Womp has a much higher drying threshold, so he will not dry normally unless he is too hot, near a fire, on fire, etc.
- Womp does not lose sanity for using wet equipment.

[b]The Pros:[/b]
- Moves faster when above 80 wetness. (Moves normally between 40 and 80 wetness.)
- Has a tiny sanity boost when above 80 wetness.
- While above 20 wetness, Womp has a chance to dodge attacks.
- Moves additionally faster and periodically heals while it is raining.
- Stays cooler in the summer, based on wetness.
- Takes less damage from fire when above 50 wetness (though taking fire damage dries Womp out VERY quickly).
- Tentacles are not hostile.
- Can spawn new tentacles using tentacle spots.
- Cannot be disarmed by moose/goose or Bearger, and wet tools do not slip.
- Does not lose sanity during dusk or night time.
- Can eat monster meat without penalty.
- Does not care about spoilage.

[b]The Cons:[/b]
- Loses wetness when hit by an attack, based on damage taken.
- Generates less wetness over time when below 25% hunger.
- Inventory items still get wet. Wet food spoils faster, wet fuel burns less.
- Moves slower when below 40 wetness.
- Greatly loses sanity over time while below 20 wetness.
- Periodically loses health while below 20 wetness.
- Loses sanity during the day (unless it's raining).
- Freezes faster in the winter, based on wetness.
- Takes more damage from fire when below 50 wetness.
- Pigmen, bunnymen, and catcoons are hostile.

--------------------
[b]Things I want to do eventually:[/b]
- Full custom animations (outside of scope currently).
- Better voice sound effects.
- Singleplayer version, including SW.

[b]Do not re-use or re-upload any art assets contained within this mod.[/b]
[b][u]Please report any bugs or crashes. Screenshots and log files are helpful.[/u][/b]

publishedfiledetails.title: Throwable Spears [broken]
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Probably pretty broken/crashy now, I haven't found time to keep this updated. ninjor1 uploaded a fixed version that you can use: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2408298309.[/h1]

Allows you to throw spears with right-click. They do the same damage as normal spear attacks. By default, you will miss (and still lose durability) if you try to hit small creatures (bunnies, butterflies, birds, bees).

This was a mod that I did mainly because I was curious about how it would be done. I've seen people asking for throwable spears to be in the game before, so I figured I'd publish it. I don't think I'll use it myself, though. Any other modders who want to use the code, feel free (for example to make your own two-mode weapons).

[h1]Options:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Miss Small Creatures: Determines the chance to miss small creatures (default to 100%).
[*] # Uses on Large: Sets the amount of durability used by throwing a spear at a large target, in terms of the number of times you can use it before it breaks. Defaults to 75, which uses twice the durability of a normal attack.
[*] # Uses on Small: Same, but for small creatures, if you hit them. Defaults to 5.
[*] Check Range: Enabled by default. You can right-click near enemies you want to throw the spear at instead of having to click directly on them. This helps for small and fast-moving targets, but the range check is a bit expensive, so if it causes lag for you, I'd recommend turning it off.
[/list]

[h1]Probably incompatible with:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=394172225]Advanced Tooltips[/url]
[/list]

publishedfiledetails.title: Global Positions -Remapped
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
The concept of "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url]" but made from the ground up to be a little easier on your computer. By default does not contain pings, for pings I recommend the "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2808279156]Global Pings[/url]" mod.

Everything was done from scratch to use more modern methods and have some nice tweaks in there too.
The mod icon is the only thing taken from "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url]".

[h1]Modes[/h1]
There are currently 3 modes to choose from in the config...

[b]Map Share[/b]
- A accurate recreation of some of the functionality of "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url]".
- Other player's icons and names will be visible on the map from any distance.
- Speed at which the map updates is based on movement speed to prevent follower after-images. (Configurable)
- All players exploration contribute to your map.
- Not retroactive, area others explore while you are off the server or in a separate shard will not be mapped.
- Moderately light weight.

[b]Easy Cartography[/b]
- A new take on the idea of map sharing.
- Very light weight, use if other mode causes too much lag.
- Other players exploration does not contribute to your map.
- Cartographer's Desk can now be interacted with, when you do, your map will be saved to the desk and any maps saved to the desk will be added to your map.
- Retroactive, fresh players can interact with a Cartographer's Desk to fill out their map with everything that any player has explored (prior to said player interacting with the Desk themselves)
- Map scrolls can still be made for use in giving it to someone who is too busy to touch the desk themselves.

[b]Both[/b] (Default)
- Contains all the features of both the other modes.
- "Easy Cartography" mode's features can be used to overcome the issue of the "Map Share" mode not being retroactive.


[h1]Notes[/h1]
This mod contains client-side config options. These can only be accessed via the main menu's mods menu.

This mod does not add any features from "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url]" that were not mentioned above. Missing features:

- Pings. If you want them back I recommend getting "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2808279156]Global Pings[/url]"
- Ability to prevent personal map sharing (Planned for a future update?)
- Wilderness Mode support. (Not planned)
- Smoke Signals. (Not planned)

[h1]Plans[/h1]
- When a player joins the server, update their map with previously explored areas. (WIP)
- Have a option for player icons show up while in "Easy Cartography" mode, maybe only while the player holds a compass?

[h1]Bugs[/h1]

- None yet, let me know if you find any!

publishedfiledetails.title: Pickle It
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Pickle your foods to make them last longer!

[h1]Pickle Barrel:[/h1]
 - Allows pickling of food
 - Craftable on the Science Machine in the Food tab
 - Takes 1.5 days to fully pickle food
 - Currently pickles: beet, berries, cabbage, carrot, corn, cucumber, eggplant, egg, fish, mushroom, onion, pigs foot, pumpkin, radish, watermelon

[h1]New vegetables:[/h1]
 - Added: beet, cabbage, cucumber, onion, potato, radish
 - Grow on farms
 - Have a random chance of growing from generic seeds (except potato)
 - Can be fed to birds for veggie-specific seeds (except potato)
 - Potatoes are grown on farms by planting potatoes (not seeds). Harvesting potatoes from a farm will yield 1-3 potatoes.
 - Can be cooked on a fire for the cooked version of each veggie
 - Beets, onions, potatoes, and radishes grow wild in the world (Pickle It needs to be active at world gen)
 - Wild potatoes must be dug up with a Shovel

[h1]New items:[/h1]
 - Pigs feet: 1-2 dropped by pigs; can be cooked, dried, and pickled
 - Pickle sword: craftable on the Science Machine in the Fight tab

We aim to balance the Pickle Barrel so that it isn't overpowered. While it makes food last longer, there is a trade-off with the pickled versions of most foods.

If you have any feedback or ideas, please leave a comment!

[h1]Don't Starve version:[/h1]
You can also play Pickle It in the original Don't Starve!
[url]http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=196051302[/url]

[h1]Tips:[/h1]
- If anything is invisible after installing the mod, try restarting the game.
- If you are getting a lot of pickled mush, make sure the food you put in the pickle barrel is not about to rot. Also, make sure you are trying to pickle foods that are picklable. Anything that isn't picklable will result in pickled mush.

publishedfiledetails.title: Upgradeable Chest
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
upgrade your chest with boards.

Larger content, same space.




Woddie and Lucy rate this 5 stars.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Q&A[/h1]

[h1]How Can I Upgrade?[/h1]
1. Put at least 1 upgrade material in all the outermost slots.
2. Close the container.

Degrade:
1. Clear your chest
2. Put 1 hammer into the chest
3. Close the container
4. It will consume 5 uses, trade for half of the upgrading material


[h1]How Large Can The Chest Be?[/h1]
Here is few options allow you to choose how many times it could update. How large? Check the last option! It is infinite!
[spoiler]in fact not but you may never reach the upper limit[spoiler]even you hit the limit, I can easily top up the limit. wanna give it a try?[/spoiler][/spoiler]


[h1]Do The Mod Break The Balance?[/h1]
Certainly not.
A normal chest has 9 slots and cost 3 boards. i.e. 3 slots for each boards

With this mod,
The 5x5 chest cost a total 11 boards with a total 25 slots, i.e. 25 / 11 = 2.2 slots per boards.
The 7x7 chest cost a total 27 boards with a total 49 slots, i.e. 49 / 27 = 1.8 slots per boards.

That means for each upgrade, you have to trade more boards for less slots.


[h1]Why there is no option under UI setting? [/h1]
It is not able to adjust UI setting in worldgen menu. You must visit mod screen in main menu for setting.
ie. Main Menu → Mods → Server Mods → Upgradable Chest

I hope UI setting could could be set by each client. All client should follow the setting from server host if I do not make it a client option. For example, if the server host turn the "Ice Box Leftward", all clients are forced on even they don't want to. That's why I make them a client option which each client follow their own setting than server's setting. Making it a client option will hide it from worldgen menu. You can only tune the options from main menu.


[h1]Why I cannot upgrade the chest?[/h1]
Test if it works with no other mods, and with default config. option of the mod. 
Here are some useful console commands for your test:
[table]
[tr]
[th]spawn a new chest[/th]
[th]c_spawn("treasurechest")[/th]
[/tr]

[th]give you 10 boards[/th]

[th]upgrade the nearest chest to 7x7[/th]

[/tr]
[/table]

If it fails, comment below. Otherwise, check the following Q&A


[h1]Is the mod conflict with other mods? How do I know which mod it is?[/h1]
If you fail to upgrade the container, check to see if you install these mods.
Here are some kind of mods that may not compat with this mod:
1. ALL mods that enlarge chest storage
2. SOME of the mods that add new containers to the game
3. SOME mods that add a new items which can hold/ store/ trade/ delete things in one of its slots


[hr][/hr]
[h1]What is needed in other container?[/h1]
After version 4.0, you can upgrade 4 more containers, i.e. ice box, salt box, dragonfly chest, fish box.
Here are the materials needed:

[table]
[tr]
[th]Ice Box[/th]
[th]1 gears in each top-most slots, 1 cut stone in each other outermost slots[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]

[th]1 boards in each outermost slots[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Fish Box[/th]
[th]1 rope in each outermost slots[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h1]Row/Column Upgrading Mode[/h1]
A new upgrading mode is added in version 7.0. Turn it on in [b]Other Functions: Upgrade Mode[/b]
Idea From: ♛ EmuLegs
[table]
[tr][th]Mode[/th][th]Detail[/th][/tr]
[tr][th]normal mode[/th][th]The mode what we are using. Refer to the above for more info.[/th][/tr]
[tr][th]expensive mode[/th][th]A more expensive and complicated mode. Put the upgrading items to all the right-most slots will extend horizontally. Put them to all the bottom-most slots will extend vertically. The items are listed below[/th][/tr]
[tr][th]complex mode[/th][th]Turn both of the above on.[/th][/tr]
[tr][th]OTHER NEW MODE[/th][th]Welcome to command below if you want your cool idea installed. I will implant them to the mode if I like the idea.[/th][/tr]

[h1]Pageable Upgrade[/h1]
You may upgrade the chest to make it "pageable". The feature has yet finalized. Welcome to discuss below.
The idea is from mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=936440913]Pageable containers[/url] by Potter_Lee. 
*****Remind: This mod is supposed not compatible with his mod. You may test and tell me if they can work together.

After you have upgraded the container to the MAX levels. Put the upgrading items to ALL the slots in FIRST page. 
The upgrading items are the most-common-used upgrade item for its normal upgrade. ie. 1 cut stone for all slots in first page, NO gears is needed.

This mod automatically adjusts the health of mobs depending on the number of active players, everytime a player joins or leaves.

Default is DS values for 1 player, and DST values for 6 players. 
(for 2,3,4,5 players , health will be between those values of course)
And in case for some reason you have more than 6 players, it will be higher than DST values!

Has setting to set min/max value for the number of players the mod should calculate with:
So if you are playing with 4+ players, but want max health values for 3, then you can set max to 3.
Or if you play with 2+ players, but want at least health values for 4 players, you can set min to 4.
Or set it both to 6 if you always want to play with values for 6 players.
By default it is disabled.

Cave and Overworld are separated. 
So if one player is in cave and one in Overworld, both worlds will have health values for 1 player.

More Customization:
in the customsettings.lua you can define your own health function!

Special case for crabking(-claws):
If a player joins/leaves during a fight against crab king, his health wont change. If you want to update his health according to new number of players, you have to leave and activate him again.

[h1]How to use the mod in dedicated server?[/h1]
Open the "mods" folder. You will see a "dedicated_server_mods_setup.lua". Double click and open it using notepad. 
Start a new line, type: 
ServerModSetup("2328604820")
where workshop-2328604820 is this mod's file name. (no need to input "workshop-". [b]number only[/b])
for mod (workshop-xxxxxxxx), you may type ServerModSetup("xxxxxxxx") in each new line.

Or if you get a mods collection, you may type this instead:
ServerModCollectionSetup("#######")
where ####### is the collection id. You may right click any empty space in the collection page and copy the page link. The collection id would be the number string after " /?id= ". All mods in the collection will be automatically downloaded.

[*]Pick Mode:

"Combine": hold spacebar to pick all species, single click to harvest 1 species

publishedfiledetails.title: ReForged
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
The Forge event has been ReForged! ReForged is the successor to Forged Forge; optimized for new content and modding support. This mod comes up with a bunch of new features that are not included in the Forge event or Forged Forge. To see all of the new features check out our patch notes. Some of the core new features include:

[h1]Voting[/h1]
Players can now vote in the lobby! This means you can now vote to kick any idlers in your lobby! You can start a vote by hitting the button for the desired vote. Votes include:
[list]
[*]Kicking
[*]Change Game Settings
[*]Force Start
[*]Cancel Force Start
[*]Levels
[/list]
Players can now earn experience when completing games. Players have an account level and character levels. The account level is the players cumulative experience of all games, while the character level is the experience gained when playing that specific character. This is purely cosmetic and does not unlock any items, but as your level increases you will notice that your player badge will change!

[h1]Game Settings Panel[/h1]
A new panel has been created which allows users to change the settings of the current game either through voting or using your admin to force change the settings. With this comes a bunch of interchangeable settings:
[b][u]Modes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Forge S01: Mobs behave as they did in the first Forge event. This currently does not affect item drops.
[*]Forge S02: Mobs behaves as they did in the second Forge event. For instance, Boarilla gains the ability to roll. This also currently does not affect item drops.
[*]ReForged: This is our own version of the Forge where we attempt to balance the game by changing mob behaviors, weapons, character perks, and anything else to enhance the experience. For example, Abigail gains a new ability in the mode! This will be continuously updated based on community feedback.
[/list]
[u][b]Difficulties[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Normal
[*]Hard: Changes mob behaviours and adds balance changes to make a Forger's life more difficult. Good Luck! (Art assets are still being developed for this)
[/list]
[b][u]Gametypes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Forge
[*]Classic Red Light/Green Light: RL/GL returns from Forged Forge. Be sure not to move on Red Light!
[*]Red Light/Green Light: A new version of RL/GL that has more lights to make things more difficult.
[/list]
[u][b]Wavesets[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Classic: The original waveset from the first Forge event.
[*]Twin Boarillas
[*]Rhinocebros
[*]Swineclops
[*]Double Trouble Classic: Mob spawns are doubled for the Classic waveset.
[*]Double Trouble: Mob spawns are doubled for the Swineclops waveset.
[*]Half the Wrath: Less mobs and they are all weaker.
[*]Sandbox: No waves, just play around using the admin menu. Needs to be turned on in the settings and at least one player will want to be admin.
[/list]
[b][u]Mutators[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Mob Stats: Adjust the damage, defense, health, and speeds of all mobs.
[*]Battlestandard Efficiency: Adjust the multiplier of banners.
[*]No Sleep: Heal Auras no longer put mobs to sleep.
[*]No Revives
[*]No HUD
[*]Friendly Fire
[/list]

[b][u]Maps[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Lava Arena
[/list]

[h1]History[/h1]
Another new tab has been created to display all of the runs you have completed in ReForged. This has been ported over from the Forge Detailed Summary mod and updated to include all of the new settings this mod has. It will only display runs from this mod. Do not worry, your runs from Forged Forge and the Forge event are untouched and unharmed by us and we may include them later on.

[h1]Modding[/h1]
Every feature seen above and much more are fully mod compatible. This means that modders can easily create new modes, difficulties, gametypes, characters, pets, and anything else using our helper functions. If you need help with creating content for this mod then stop by our discord and post in our modding channel. We will gladly help you out. Here is a list of guides and API to help you with your modding:
More coming soon.
[url=https://discord.gg/wSZD2hFyuV][img]https://i.imgur.com/psVYTBu.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Special Thanks[/h1]
Thank you for all you Forgers for “patiently” waiting for this transition to occur and thanks to everyone who helped test and gather information.

Also, thank you to all translators for translating the giant string file:
Alice! - Chinese
동각자 - Korean
More coming soon

Devon is really just a character from a personal project that I like to make for most games. He's a fast and nimble, but he can't take a hit worth a damn. He's also fairly insane as it is, suffering from hallucinations of a near-death experience, so he fit pretty well into Don't Starve.

Devon is a greedy bastard and very specially trained as a thief and hunter - it's pretty much all he can do. He's extremely quick and lightfooted, but he's very weak and, honestly, stupid. Despite his attempts, he can't eascape both the psychological and physiological aspects of his species.

Devon's specially trained pet that helps him steal sh*t and keeps him company. She is his best friend and he keeps her from any danger for fear of losing her. He never goes anywhere without his Birdy.
